extracted.intended_audience: scientists, engineers, policymakers, AAAS members and prospective members, and the general public interested in AAAS's purpose and priorities
extracted.subtask_description: Organizational mission, vision, and strategic goals for the American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS), describing priorities that guide its activities, membership, publication, and engagement with policy and communities.

rubrics_metrics.name: AAAS MISSION
rubrics_metrics.description: Advance science, engineering, and innovation throughout the world for the benefit of all. Advancing Science, Serving Society.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statement of the organization's core purpose; frames all AAAS activities as serving to advance STEM fields globally for societal benefit.

rubrics_metrics.name: AAAS VISION STATEMENT
rubrics_metrics.description: A boldly inclusive, mobilized, and global scientific community that ignites, enables, and celebrates scientific excellence and science-informed decisions and actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aspirational description of the future state AAAS seeks to enable; emphasizes inclusivity, mobilization, global scope, and science-informed decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advance scientific excellence and achievement
rubrics_metrics.description: AAAS recognizes, inspires, and enables a robust research ecosystem that drives discovery and innovation and prepares future scientists and engineers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Priority to support and strengthen research ecosystems, foster discovery and innovation, and invest in training/preparation of future STEM workforce.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foster inclusivity for scientific excellence
rubrics_metrics.description: AAAS fosters the open and inclusive scientific enterprise that is essential for scientific excellence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes equity and openness in the scientific enterprise as a necessary condition for high-quality science; guides programs and membership outreach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Build trust among scientists and communities
rubrics_metrics.description: AAAS builds trust among scientists and engineers and broader communities and is a valued source of accurate scientific information that is foundational to countering misinformation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mandates activities and communications that increase public trust and provide accurate information to counter misinformation; informs engagement and outreach standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Catalyze progress where science meets policy
rubrics_metrics.description: AAAS provides actionable evidence for public policy that serves society and promotes policies that enable quality science.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frames AAAS's role in producing and translating evidence for policy, and in advocating for policy environments that support rigorous science.

rubrics_metrics.name: Member-focused organization / Open membership
rubrics_metrics.description: Membership is open to anyone who shares our goals and belief that science, technology, engineering, and mathematics can help solve many of the challenges the world faces today.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets a broad, inclusive eligibility principle for membership and positions membership as a way to support AAAS efforts on behalf of scientists, educators, and students.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preserve and provide access to AAAS history and archives
rubrics_metrics.description: The AAAS archives are open to researchers interested in the history of the association and its role in the development of science. The archives hold administrative and program records, as well as records for the journal Science.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commitment to maintaining historical records and providing researcher access; informs archival and transparency practices.
